title: Shujinkou no Osananajimi ga, Wakiyaku no Ore ni Guigui Kuru
titleRomaji: Shujinkou no Osananajimi ga, Wakiyaku no Ore ni Guigui Kuru
titleNative: 主人公の幼馴染が、脇役の俺にグイグイくる
synopsis: Kazuki Ishii has his life turned upside down — and is driven to suicide — after getting caught up in the romantic entanglements of his friend Teruhito Amada, who is wildly popular with the opposite sex, like the hero of a romantic comedy. However, a miracle occurs, and time is rewound back to the morning of his high school entrance ceremony. In his second chance at life, Kazuki tries to keep a low profile, avoid making friends, and live a peaceful life. But for some reason, Meiko Hikata — Amada’s childhood friend and a cool beauty known as the “Ice Empress”—begins to take an interest in him. (Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Myther
synopsis: In the 2nd year of Enka, a scientist invented Myther, a device designed to create an ideal personality. With it, people could become their ideal selves and break away from their weak selves. However, underneath the surface, Myther Crime - a hidden social issue - has emerged, where those who abuse Myther suffer from their minds breaking, before carrying out horrific acts of violence. Kyou, an agent of the Special Intelligence Agency under direct command of the Japanese authorities, secretly takes on the fight against these crimes. All for the sake of his unwavering loyalty to the government… (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Mikoto-chan wa Kirawaretakunai!
titleNative: みことちゃんは嫌われたくない!
synopsis: My beautiful, big-breasted childhood friend, Mikoto, is completely in love with me. It sounds like a dream scenario that anyone would envy — but there’s just one big problem... She’s turned into a clingy, mentally unstable mess with love that's way too heavy!! This is a dark everyday comedy about being at the mercy of Mikoto’s unstable behavior and unintentional sexiness. Note: Mikoto-chan wa Kirawaretakunai! began as a web manga shared on the author's Twitter starting February 15, 2023, and has been published in print by Kadokawa since January 18, 2024.

title: Fuuto Tantei
synopsis: In the ecologically-minded city of Fuuto, mysterious devices resembling USB flash drives called Gaia Memories are used by criminals and other interested parties to become monsters called Dopants, committing crimes with the police force powerless to stop them. To make matters worse, the Gaia Memories carry a dangerous toxin that cause their users to go insane to the point where they could die from the life-threatening devices. After the death of his boss, the self-proclaimed hard-boiled detective Shoutarou Hidari works with the mysterious Philip to investigate crimes which involve Dopants. Using their own Gaia Memories, Shoutarou and Philip use the Double Driver belts to transform and combine into Kamen Rider Double to fight the Dopant menace and keep Fuuto safe. (Source: Kamen Rider W Wiki) Note: Fuuto Tantei is a manga adaptation and sequel of the 2009 drama TV series Kamen Rider W .

synonyms: I Remember the Love for My Angel
synopsis: Meet Julio, a gay thirty-year-old man and best-selling author. Despite his success in publishing, however, Julio lives a life of solitude, keeping his true identity a secret while harboring feelings of inferiority regarding his sexuality and bland appearance. His world is soon turned upside-down, though, when he encounters a beautiful young man by the name of Angel. Standing up against the world's discriminations and prejudices, the two are soon captivated by each other... Dedicated to all who are seeking romance, this is a story of cinematic human love!! (Source: Renta!)

title: Dustland
synopsis: In the Utsusemi District of Toaru City—where Suzuran All-Boys High School towers over the landscape—a young boy named Asada Hibari has moved into the Nakahara Apartments, a place better known as "The Ghost Projects." Still trapped in the shadow of his mother's death, Hibari remains unable to escape his suffocating loneliness. However, a chance meeting with Kobayashi Sanzou, a resident of the same building, begins to lead his youth toward something hotter and more irreplaceable than anything he’s ever known!! (Source: Akita Shoten, translated)
